meta.title: RS Studio — Scalable, performant software
meta.description: Software studio building scalable, performant products. Embedded teams or end-to-end projects from architecture to release.

hero.title: Software that strengthens local businesses and communities
hero.intro: We build websites, digital products, automation systems, and custom software that help small businesses grow, operate more efficiently, and reach more customers.
hero.introMission:
We believe **great technology** should not be reserved for large companies.

Our mission is to build practical **digital solutions** that strengthen local economies, support community-driven projects, and give independent businesses access to **the same quality of tools** used by larger organizations.
hero.closing: When local businesses grow, everyone grows.
hero.screenAlt: A client site built by the studio, shown on a desktop screen
hero.phoneAlt: A client site built by the studio, shown on a phone
